verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Plaka, Elounda, Crete.
verified_facts.excerpt: Address: Plaka, Elounda, Crete 72053 Greece

verified_facts.text: Spinalonga islet lies across from Phaea Blue in the Gulf of Elounda.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across Phāea Blue, the isle of Spinalonga lies peacefully in the Gulf of Elounda.

verified_facts.text: Spinalonga was an inland fortress for centuries, then a leper colony in the first half of the 20th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: For centuries it was an inland fortress, then a leper colony in the first half of the 20th century.

verified_facts.text: Elounda is 3.6 km from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elounda: 3.6 km of the resort

verified_facts.text: Knossos is 69 km from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Knossos: 69 km of the resort

verified_facts.text: The bungalows look out over the Aegean Sea and Spinalonga Island, with contemporary design in subtle hues and Mediterranean-style accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: The captivating allure of the Aegean Sea and Spinalonga Island unfolds before you, embraced by the artful design of the serene bungalows, where the contemporary ambiance is delicately woven with subtle hues and Mediterranean-style accents

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Bungalow Seaview Private Heated Pool has its own private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The perfect veranda into the Aegean, with its own private pool.

verified_facts.text: Illustrator Philippos Theodorides painted murals in spaces such as the Island Luxury Suites and the Phaea Blue Villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featured in spaces like the Island Luxury Suites and Phāea Blue Villa, his art transforms walls into vibrant narratives

verified_facts.text: Yannis Sbokos bought the land where Phaea Blue stands in the late 1980s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our story starts with our father, Yannis Sbokos, who in the late '80s bought the land where Phāea Blue lies today.

verified_facts.text: The hotel partners with the Benaki Museum on curated collections and local craftsmanship that showcase Greek heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Phāea Blue partners with the Benaki Museum to showcase Greece’s rich heritage. Curated collections and local craftsmanship immerse guests in the island’s vibrant past.

verified_facts.text: Handwoven textiles crafted by the grandmother of the owners are used in the hotel's spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are honored to incorporate handwoven textiles crafted by the grandmother of our owners, Agapi Sbokou.

verified_facts.text: Guests can buy exclusive items at a Benaki Shop corner in the hotel's retail space.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can also explore and purchase exclusive items from the Benaki Shop corner in our retail space.

verified_facts.text: Ceramics by Melina Xenaki are found throughout the hotel, including the lobby and guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: which can be found throughout Phāea Blue, including the lobby and guest rooms

verified_facts.text: The spa is surrounded by gardens framing the Aegean Sea, used for yoga, meditation and fitness.
verified_facts.excerpt: Imagine being surrounded by beautifully curated gardens that frame the beauty of Aegean Sea, offering a sanctuary for yoga, meditation, and fitness enthusiasts.

verified_facts.text: Yoga and meditation sessions are regular features on the daily activities calendar.
verified_facts.excerpt: These soul-soothing sessions are regular features on our daily activities calendar

verified_facts.text: Visiting wellness specialists offer massages, energy healing, acupuncture, holistic therapies and mindfulness workshops.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering a range of services including soothing massages, energy healing, acupuncture, as well as holistic therapies and mindfulness workshops

verified_facts.text: An outdoor deck hosts yoga sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto our outdoor deck for invigorating yoga sessions

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Apiceuticals bath products, a brand rooted in organic and ethical beekeeping since 1981.
verified_facts.excerpt: In our rooms, indulge in the ultimate pampering with Apiceuticals, a brand rooted in a legacy of organic and ethical beekeeping since 1981

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an Immersive Movie Area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether for a romantic evening or a cozy gathering, the Immersive Movie Area offers pure cinematic bliss.

verified_facts.text: Anthos serves contemporary Greek cuisine built on local farms and seasonal produce.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is Anthós - the freshest take on Greek contemporary cuisine with innovative food concepts, that follow the rhythms of the land and sea.

verified_facts.text: Blue Door Taverna, set in a former fisherman's stone house, serves traditional Cretan cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once an old fisherman’s stone house, Blue Door is an enchanting atmosphere to taste timeless traditional Cretan cuisine.

verified_facts.text: There is a beachfront bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the ultimate relaxation by the sea as you savor delicious cocktails and soak up the lively atmosphere at our beachfront bar.

verified_facts.text: At the Phaea Farmers Feast, guests handpick ingredients in the organic garden with a Phaea Farmer and the executive chef, then share a communal table.
verified_facts.excerpt: this event allows guests to handpick the freshest ingredients alongside a Phāea Farmer and Phāea Blue's Executive Chef, Giannis Kalivretakis

verified_facts.text: The Farmers Feast includes cooking directly in the soil.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the age-old tradition of cooking directly in the soil

verified_facts.text: Experiences include sunset cruises around Spinalonga.
verified_facts.excerpt: From sunset cruises around Spinalonga to authentic feasts

verified_facts.text: A traditional caique experience visits remote beaches and cobalt waters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find yourself surrounded by fresh air, remote beaches, cobalt waters, and an abundance of fascinating energy.

verified_facts.text: An olive oil tasting is held around the olive tree at Anthos' outdoor kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set around the olive tree at Anthós' outdoor kitchen, this intimate experience invites guests to discover Crete's most treasured ingredient, its olive oil.

verified_facts.text: Wine tastings take place in the organic garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: An immersion into the world of Greek wine with our Wine Tasting experience, in our organic garden.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a village tour of Crete in a vintage Mercedes or Cadillac.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hop inside our vintage Mercedes or Cadillac and embark on a mini-road-trip to the traditional villages of Crete.

verified_facts.text: Private dining can be a romantic beachside table or a candlelit dinner in your villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: A romantic beachside table or an intimate candlelit dinner in your villa

verified_facts.text: Guests get special discounts at the Crete Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay with a visit to the Crete Golf Club and enjoy special discounts as a guest of Phāea Blue.

verified_facts.text: Greek cooking classes focus on the island's traditional recipes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for a Greek cooking class, focusing on the island's authentic flavors and traditional recipes.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a bee-friendly landscape with seasonal gardens, flowering plants and water sources under its Plan Bee initiative.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aligned with our Plan Bee initiative, we’ve created a bee-friendly landscape featuring seasonal gardens, vibrant flowering plants, and ample water sources.
